messages.content: How many minutes are there in a week?

messages.reasoning_content: A day has 24 hours of 60 minutes, so 1440 minutes. A week has 7 days: 7 x 1440 = 10080.
messages.content: There are 10,080 minutes in a week (7 days x 24 hours x 60 minutes).

messages.reasoning_content: A leap year has 366 days, and 366 x 1440 = 527040.
messages.content: A leap year has 527,040 minutes (366 days x 1,440 minutes per day).

messages.content: What is the difference between a list and a tuple in Python?
A list is mutable: you can append, remove or reassign its items. A tuple is immutable once created, which makes it hashable (when its items are) and usable as a dictionary key.
Explain in one paragraph how a suspension bridge carries its load.

Suspension bridges carry their deck on vertical hangers attached to two main cables. The cables drape over tall towers and are anchored in massive blocks of concrete at each end, so almost all of the load reaches the ground as tension pulling on those anchorages.

Write a short paragraph about how tide pools support marine life.

Tide pools form where the retreating sea leaves water trapped among rocks. Twice a day their residents endure swings in temperature, salinity and oxygen that would kill most open-water animals. Barnacles seal their plates shut, anemones fold inward, and hermit crabs shuffle between crevices until the tide returns.
